title: CORRELATE CIFTI ROWS AND TAKE GRADIENT
description: For each structure, compute the correlation of the rows in the structure, and take the gradients of the resulting rows, then average them.  Memory limit does not need to be an integer, you may also specify 0 to use as little memory as possible (this may be very slow).

left_corrected_areas.description: vertex areas to use instead of computing them from the left surface

left_surface.description: specify the left surface to use

right_corrected_areas.description: vertex areas to use instead of computing them from the right surface

right_surface.description: specify the right surface to use

cerebellum_corrected_areas.description: vertex areas to use instead of computing them from the cerebellum surface

cerebellum_surface.description: specify the cerebellum surface to use

surface_presmooth.description: smooth on the surface before computing the gradient

volume_presmooth.description: smooth the volume before computing the gradient

presmooth_fwhm.description: smoothing kernel sizes are FWHM, not sigma

undo_fisher_z.description: apply the inverse fisher small z transform to the input

fisher_z.description: apply the fisher small z transform to the correlations before taking the gradient

surface_exclude.description: exclude vertices near each seed vertex from computation

volume_exclude.description: exclude voxels near each seed voxel from computation

fisher_z_first.description: after the FIRST correlation, apply fisher small z transform (ie, artanh)

no_demean_first.description: instead of correlation for the FIRST operation, do dot product of rows, then normalize by diagonal

covariance_first.description: instead of correlation for the FIRST operation, compute covariance

double_correlation.description: do two correlations before taking the gradient
